cover.prompt: On the terrace before the colonnade legislator-man stands writing on an open papyrus scroll while paxos-messenger hands him a small papyrus slip.
cover.others: a dozen more legislators in long white chitons with a purple band at the hem, each carrying a scroll, strolling across the terrace and in and out by the one open door, and three more messengers in short blue exomides running between them.

p01-scrolls.prompt: legislator-man and legislator-woman sit well apart on the stone benches round the wall, each writing on their own papyrus scroll; paxos-messenger walks across the floor; scholar walks out by the open door.
p01-scrolls.others: three more legislators in long white chitons with purple hems, each alone on a bench, writing on a scroll.

p02-hourglass.prompt: legislator-woman sits on the stone bench writing on her papyrus scroll; legislator-man stands beside her, watching the sand run in the small sandglass standing on the bench, which he has just turned over.

p03-messengers.prompt: legislator-man sits on a stone bench with his scroll while paxos-messenger stands before him handing him a small folded papyrus slip; further along the wall legislator-woman writes on her scroll.
p03-messengers.others: two more young messengers in short blue exomides with hide sacks crossing the floor, one walking towards the door and one away from it.

p04-synod.prompt: priest walks along the terrace beside the colonnade.
p04-synod.others: four more priests of different ages, builds and faces, dressed like priest in plain white chitons with red cord belts and olive wreaths, wandering round the colonnade at their own pace: one walks towards the steps, two walk away from them, one stands shading his eyes. Nobody addresses anyone.

p05-oki.prompt: scholar sits on the stone bench, bent over his papyrus scroll, copying decrees onto it from another scroll open beside him; in front of the bench legislator-man stands with arms folded, legislator-woman looks down at the scroll, and paxos-messenger stands waiting.

p06-cheese.prompt: On the quay, where the town holds its market, three wheels of pale cheese stand on the paving among the amphorae. Two cheese inspectors give opposite verdicts on the same cheeses: scholar raises his hand in approval while the other inspector points at the cheese, frowning; merchant looks on; goatherd stands behind.
p06-cheese.others: the other inspector, a lean older man in a long ochre chiton, and one more plump merchant in a cream chiton.

p07-goats.prompt: On the road merchant speaks to legislator-man, who holds his open papyrus scroll and looks down at it in thought; goatherd waits beside them with three shaggy black goats, real animals with long dark hair and curved horns.
